def rects(g):
 R,C=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[]
 # enumerate rectangular 1-runs via top,bottom, intersection contiguous intervals
 for t in range(R):
  cols=[True]*C
  for b in range(t,R):
   cols=[cols[c] and g[b][c]!=0 for c in range(C)]
   c=0
   while c<C:
    if not cols[c]: c+=1; continue
    a=c
    while c<C and cols[c]: c+=1
    z=c-1
    # maximal if cannot extend top/bottom or left/right (latter by maximal run)
    if t>0 and all(g[t-1][x]!=0 for x in range(a,z+1)): continue
    if b<R-1 and all(g[b+1][x]!=0 for x in range(a,z+1)): continue
    out.append((t,a,b,z))
 return out
